items.name: Temperance
items.text: Eat not to dulness; drink not to elevation.

items.name: Silence
items.text: Speak not but what may benefit others or yourself; avoid trifling conversation.

items.name: Order
items.text: Let all your things have their places; let each part of your business have its time.

items.name: Resolution
items.text: Resolve to perform what you ought; perform without fail what you resolve.

items.name: Frugality
items.text: Make no expense but to do good to others or yourself; i.e., waste nothing.

items.name: Industry
items.text: Lose no time; be always employ'd in something useful; cut off all unnecessary actions.

items.name: Sincerity
items.text: Use no hurtful deceit; think innocently and justly, and, if you speak, speak accordingly.

items.name: Justice
items.text: Wrong none by doing injuries, or omitting the benefits that are your duty.

items.name: Moderation
items.text: Avoid extreams; forbear resenting injuries so much as you think they deserve.

items.name: Cleanliness
items.text: Tolerate no uncleanliness in body, cloaths, or habitation.

items.name: Tranquillity
items.text: Be not disturbed at trifles, or at accidents common or unavoidable.

items.name: Chastity
items.text: Rarely use venery but for health or offspring, never to dulness, weakness, or the injury of your own or another's peace or reputation.
